label: Business employee
notes: Employer and employee share the contribution; employer also pays EC.

label: Household employee (kasambahay)
notes: Employer pays everything below PHP5,000 actual compensation; shared from PHP5,000. Look up by salary only: two PHP5,000 salary-credit rows exist.

label: Land-based OFW
notes: Member pays everything; no EC. Minimum salary credit PHP8,000. No currency conversion.

label: Voluntary member
notes: Member pays everything; no EC. Look up by an approved monthly salary credit.

label: Non-working spouse
notes: Member pays everything; no EC. Look up by an approved monthly salary credit; the basis is not derived here.

label: Sea-based OFW (seafarer)
notes: Uses the employer/employee table; the manning agency is the employer. No currency conversion.
